scope: I06 bounded MACD-only standalone research; no ladder/live changes or indicator/HL/SR combinations.
formula: Fast and slow EMAs each SMA-seeded after own period, update prev + alpha*(close-prev), alpha=2/(period+1). Line=fast-slow, signal=EMA(line) SMA-seeded using first signalPeriod valid lines, histogram=line-signal. Null during warmup, zero valid; raw price units. Fixed June1 start, no gap/reseed. 12/26/9 standard; faster/slower presets are declared sensitivity choices, not claimed universal standards.

entryRules.signal_cross: Long previous histogram<=0 and current>0; short previous>=0 and current<0. Histogram zero cross equals line/signal cross, not extra independent confirmation.
entryRules.signal_trend: Same fresh histogram cross, current line>0 long/<0 short; intrinsic MACD trend-sign conditioning, not another indicator.
entryRules.signal_counter: Same fresh histogram cross, current line<0 long/>0 short; exactly-zero line excluded from both conditioned variants.
entryRules.zero_cross: Long previous MACD line<=0 and current>0; short previous>=0 and current<0; signal-line warmup not required.
entryRules.hist_turn: Three completed bars: long previous histogram slope<=0, current slope>0, current histogram<0; short previous slope>=0,current slope<0,current histogram>0. No centered/future pivot.

exitRules: 12h from actual entry, or earliest subsequent completed condition capped at12h: zero_cross long line<=0/short>=0; signal_cross/trend/counter long hist<=0/short>=0; hist_turn long hist>=0/short<=0. Not a stop or profit guarantee. Timeout wins ties; entry-time feature cannot exit; pending exits immutable.
timing: Contiguous finalized selected-timeframe bars; next minute-open, modeled0 publication lag or separate+1m every entry and exit. Full fixed seed; no execution-minute H/L/C at decision, no future bar or sliding reseed.
inventory: One independent $10k position; no compounding/averaging. Occupied/pending crossings skipped, fresh signal after exit. Open cutoff inventory marked including hypothetical close fee; not counted as completed.
funding: Excluded due incomplete settlement evidence. After trading fees before funding; no liquidation/shared-account/queue/live fills certification.
researchScreen: Same inherited screen: >=30full/10recent closes in both delays, positive net and own-side clock delta allfour; no monthly marked delta below-1e-8; positive extra5bps/side and no equity exhaustion.
ranking: All300 by full0m delta versus own-side clock, also absolute net per side. Descriptive sample/net/stress/solvent subset allfour cases, rank full0m absolute net; top5 if available else rawtop5, failures retained. No relaxed deployment gate.
reporting: Baselines alongside W/L counts/dollars, net/open/DD; full/recent periods, monthly top5 and rawtop5, both delays/cost stress, all definitions, own-entry12h exit deltas, worst paths/winner concentration. If subset<5 retain actual subset size, do not pad with failures.
overlapParity: 8 clock side/window/delay cases must match old engine and saved I01 ledgers/months/stats exactly before outcomes. No prior MACD definitions repeated. Additional synthetic forced-cross accounting parity with old engine.
limitations: 300 correlated mined definitions, overlapping windows; not untouched holdout or family exhaustion. No magnitude normalization/PPO, price divergence, multi-timeframe confirmation, threshold grid, other presets, daily, stops/targets/trailing/partials, indicators/HL/SR or ladder/portfolio applications.
writes: New local artifact directory only, refuse overwrite, source/data fingerprints unchanged; findings/register updates after independent verification. No commit/push/live changes.
